title: IVIM dataset
author: Eric Peterson
license_evidence: The versioned Figshare metadata explicitly identifies CC0 for this dataset.
source_processing: The depositor reports 21 b-values acquired in three directions, registered and direction-averaged into 21 volumes before deposition. The b-vectors are described as averaged directions.
provenance_limits: This is a public acquired, already processed demonstration dataset, not evidence that the original Le Bihan 1988 cohort is available.
The deposited metadata provides no linked study, cohort demographics, acquisition date, scanner protocol details, or independent perfusion ground truth.
The 21 stored b-vector columns are identical [0,0,1]; they do not identify the original three acquired directions.
The source fit.nii.gz (Figshare file 5305255) is deliberately excluded: a supplied fit is neither an observation nor independent biological truth.

scientific_context.relationship: IVIM method context only; this deposited dataset is not identified as the paper's original sample.

checksum_evidence.published_digest: Figshare supplied_md5 and computed_md5 agree for each selected file; both were read before download.
checksum_evidence.sha256_basis: Computed from freshly downloaded original bytes after matching the independently published MD5 and size; not claimed as upstream-published SHA-256.
checksum_evidence.mirror_basis: DIPY 1.12.1 documents mapping ndownloader.figshare.com/files/ID to workshop.dipy.org/services/data/files/ID as a transport fallback; the same pinned checksums remain mandatory.

observed_geometry.processing_applied_during_staging: None. Original bytes and original Figshare filenames are retained; no reorientation, resampling, averaging, or fitting.
